name: abstraction-compiler-type-system-type-evaluator-impl
skipped_reasons: Did not extract the shared TypeVar/ParamSpec keyword-argument parser. The two loops are not actually interchangeable: the TypeVar loop also collects constraint types in the same pass and `continue`s past every KWPair (including non-Name keys), while the ParamSpec loop has no constraint pass. Splitting them into two passes would reorder `get_type_of_expression` calls (and therefore diagnostic emission) between bound-kwargs and constraints; keeping one pass would need a helper threading three in/out values through a tuple to save roughly ten lines, which reads worse than the duplication. Only the string-literal extractor was shared.

Did not merge the `uni.SetCompr()` / `uni.GenCompr()` match arms. They differ in shape from the list/set literal arms (they call `_walk_compr_clauses` between instance creation and element typing and take no expected type), so `_container_type_args` does not cover them; merging them into one arm needs an or-pattern plus a reordering of the `self.prefetch` None guard to pick the class safely, for about eight lines saved.
